_readme: Company holdings: the one file behind /holdings/ and the Disclosure line on reports (components/holdings/).
Policy (disclaimer/, section 8): disclose WHETHER a position is held, never how much. Never add amount, size, value, quantity or entry-price fields; the page refuses to show an entry that has one.
lastUpdated: YYYY-MM-DD, shown at the top of the page. Change it every time you edit this file.

holdings: one entry per token. ticker (e.g. "BTC"), name (e.g. "Bitcoin"), status ("held" or "not-held"), disclosed (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: logo (path from the site root without the size, e.g. "assets/logos/bitcoin", needs -64.png and -128.png), report: { "title": "...", "url": "/reports/btc/" }.
changes: the public record, newest first. date (YYYY-MM-DD), ticker, event ("Position opened" or "Position closed"). Optional: note. Never delete an entry; add a new one.
